said.tool-results/unattended: Needs confirmation, no one to confirm
said.tool-results/approval-timed-out: No one confirmed in time, denied automatically
said.tool-results/crashed: Internal error, may be partly done
said.permissions/forbidden: This is LiteMiyu's own data and can't be accessed
said.permissions/unresolvable: Cannot determine where the path points: {reason}
said.commands/loop-dynamic: Loop started: the AI picks when to run next · {text}
said.commands/loop-auto: Loop started: the AI decides what to do and when to run next
said.commands/loop-off: Stopped this session's loops and scheduled continuations.
said.config/reference-header: Every LiteMiyu setting and its default. This file is generated. Editing it has no effect.
said.config/reference-where: The config file is config.toml in the config directory.
said.config/facts: Allowed values: {values}. Can be set only in {layers}. {applies}.
said.config/unknown-secret: {key} refers to the secret {name}, which is not set
said.config/env-not-set: {key} refers to {name}, which was not set when LiteMiyu started
said.config/no-provider: {key} points at the provider {name}, which is not configured
said.config/unknown-effort: {key} is {name}, which this model does not support; requests are sent as if it were not set
said.config/temperature-unsupported: {key}: this model does not support temperature; requests are sent as if it were not set
said.config/temperature-too-high: {key} is {got}, above this model's limit of {max}; requests are sent as if it were not set
said.config/bad-secret-name: {key} is not a valid secret name: it must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters
said.config/bad-secret-value: The value of {key} must be a non-empty quoted string
said.config/too-big: The file is over 1 MiB and was not read
said.config/wrong-layer: {key} can only be set in {layers}; it has no effect in {layer}
said.config/not-tightening: A project config can only make limits stricter. {key} is {current}, and {got} here is looser, so it has no effect
said.config/private-not-shipped: {got} is not a built-in private directory; only built-in ones can be removed
said.config/private-bad-path: {got} is not valid: it must be ~/… or an absolute path
said.config/private-too-broad: {got} is your home directory or above it and can't be private, or commands couldn't read their tools and settings
said.config/readonly-not-shipped: {got} is not a built-in protected path; only built-in ones can be removed
said.config/readonly-bad-path: {got} is not valid: it must be ~/…, an absolute path, or a relative path inside the workspace (without ..)
said.config/readonly-too-broad: {got} is your home directory or above it and can't be protected as a whole, or every change in your home directory would need confirmation
said.config/source-reserved: official is the name of the official package source and cannot be used by other sources
said.config/source-incomplete: Package source {name} needs both url and key
said.config/source-key: The key of package source {name} cannot be read: it must be a base64 Ed25519 public key
said.config/expected/lines: text of at most {max} characters; line breaks allowed
said.config/expected/english: one line of English, at most {max} characters
said.config/expected/duration: a length of time from {min} to {max}, written like 30s, 10m or 1h
said.config/expected/url: an address starting with http:// or https://
said.config/expected/name: a name starting with a lowercase letter, using only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters
said.config/expected/id: it must start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 32 characters
said.config/expected/model-name: it must be 1 to 128 bytes without control characters
said.config/expected/long-name: it must be 1 to 128 characters without . or control characters
said.config/bad-segment: {name} in {key} is not a valid name: {expected}
